worldMapHeadline: Whatever your path, we are here for you!
backingText: We won the UK's biggest start-up competition (Scottish EDGE) for disrupting a broken industry. Supported by TheVenturesLab as an official Social Enterprise, we are backed by national institutions because we prioritise your long-term career over short-term commissions.
certifiedHeading:
Certified by
British Council and ICEF
certifiedText: Our entire team is trained and certified by the world's leading international education authorities. You get expert, unbiased guidance on universities and visas, ensuring your application meets the highest global standards.
networkHeading:
Embedded in the UK's
Elite Business Network.
networkText: We aren't just an agency; we are a high-growth UK enterprise. Backed by top-tier accelerators (Barclays Eagle Labs, RBS), leading universities, and national business chambers, our global infrastructure is built on the same institutional trust and rigorous standards as the companies we partner with.

journeySteps.title: Your journey starts with the
journeySteps.description: While other consultants shove random degrees down your Oesophagus, we actually care about who you are. Our Magic-Spell "Revelio" blends your passion, dreams, and skillset into one powerful profile so we can finally understand the complete, complex, amazing human that is you.

journeySteps.title: Find your
journeySteps.description: No more guessing games. We map your unique profile to the world's best-fit universities and courses. It's not about where everyone is going—it's about where you will thrive, grow, and conquer.

journeySteps.title: Fuel your
journeySteps.description: From visas to pre-departure, we're with you till the very end. But our support doesn't stop at the airport. We provide career guidance and networking to ensure your international journey turns into a lifetime of success.

testimonialsTitle: They Made It. So Can You!
testimonialsLead: Hear from our students who turned uncertainty into confidence and found their place in the world.

testimonials.quote: I walked in with plans to study engineering. Through conversations and career mapping, I realised game design was where I truly belonged. I can't thank the team enough for helping me see my potential clearly and guiding me every step of the way — from building my portfolio to writing my personal statement.
testimonials.name: Rhea Menon

testimonials.quote: Hubble Bubble didn't just help with applications — they helped me discover why I was applying.
testimonials.name: Priya Sinha
